name: iasd-mangueiras-monorepo
description: Monorepo da Plataforma IASD Mangueiras (Angular 22 SSR + Firebase Cloud Functions TypeScript)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "FRONT,FUNCTIONS" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix frontend start" "npm --prefix functions run build:watch"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix functions run build
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run build
